# use-geography

RustUse geography utilities and facade set.

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-geography/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-geography/

- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-geography
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt
